You: Mrs. Fisher! I know that it might sound weird, but I need your help!
Mrs. Fisher: First of all, shush. You are scaring the fish away.
Mrs. Fisher: Second of all, I’m busy. There’s a huge one on my line right now.
You: My friend really needs help. One of her models didn’t show up to the fashion show and now all her hard work might go to waste.
Mrs. Fisher: Fashion show? Kid, do you really think an older woman like me is gonna put on some frills and whatnot? Good joke.
Mrs. Fisher: Give up. No matter what you say, I won’t let that fish get away. 
You: But-!
Mrs. Fisher: I’m disappointed. I thought that you understood the importance of honoring the duel between the fisher and their prey.
You: I do, but I also care about my friends.
Mrs. Fisher: Spare me the sob story. Friendships come and go. Fishing on the other hand never leaves you, as long as you have the strength left to hold your rod.
You: Is fishing really that important to you?
Mrs. Fisher: That’s all I got, kid. 
You: Are you really fine like this? Isolating yourself from everything other than fish?
Mrs. Fisher: I didn’t choose this path. It chose me. You are too young to get it. You have your whole life before you. When you get to my age, you will understand. 
You: Maybe you are right. Maybe someday I will leave everything behind and just fish like you, but right now I want to help my friend.
#mrsfisher.face.angry
Mrs. Fisher: Preposterous.
Mrs. Fisher: I wouldn’t suspect a fisher like you of having so little conviction! 
Mrs. Fisher: Go away! And while you’re at it throw all your rods, all your baits, and all your trophies into the sea! I would rather not share my fishing spot with such a spineless-
#mrsfisher.face.normal
Mrs. Fisher: …
Mrs. Fisher: My line broke…
Mrs. Fisher: Yeah, I guess I have little time to spare. Lead the way.
You: …
You: S-Sure, it’s this way…
